timeline_summary: Norman Eric Roberts, a 68-year-old male with chronic low back pain and spinal stenosis, has a history of two laminectomies (2009, 2012) and an epidural steroid injection in May 2016. Current records indicate a planned laminectomy at L2-3 with Dr. Moller on June 22, 2016, following a pre-operative physical and telephone consult. His medical history includes hypertension, diabetes, and allergies to sulfa and penicillin. Medications include tramadol (until June 2), lisinopril, metformin, and atorvastatin. Pre-operative instructions include stopping tramadol by June 2 and attending a Perioperative Medicine Physical. Post-operative follow-up is scheduled for July 15. The timeline reflects a stable chronic condition with planned surgical intervention, though no acute complications or recent flare-ups are documented.
